hypothesis: A fixed Clark Hash sparse signed projection plus an int4 least-squares correction can pay for a sparser ternary residual and reduce exported Qwen3.8-27B layer weight error by at least 0.1% at no more than 1.57 projected component bits per sampled weight

clark_hash_source.method_reused: SplitMix64-derived sparse signed Johnson-Lindenstrauss buckets and signs with s updates per input coordinate
clark_hash_source.important_change: the layer experiment trains the sketch coefficients by exact least squares and adds a sparse ternary residual; it does not apply the embedding codec unchanged

candidate_family.representation: W approximately equals T plus A R
candidate_family.training_step: alternate exact fixed-support ternary residual projection and exact ridge-stabilized least-squares fit of A
candidate_family.hash_coefficient_export: signed per-output-row int4 with one FP16 scale
candidate_family.ternary_scale_storage_projection: one FP16 row anchor plus 4-bit group ratio index and a 16-entry tensor codebook
candidate_family.candidate_selection: lowest aggregate int4-hash plus FP16-ternary-scale squared error across all three frozen spans
